summary: Frontend-only verification of the unified Snapchat + Meta Ads dashboard simplification, plus backend pytest regression on the 2 listed files. All requested checks PASS. Snapchat card renders exactly 4 'Today' + 4 'Month' cards (snap-spend/orders/revenue/roas-{today,month}); refresh button data-testid='snap-refresh-today-btn' text='تحديث فوري للصرف اليوم'; no '$' or 'USD' text inside any snap card label; footer link snap-card-details-link href='/reports/ads'. Meta card empty-state (admin@hesab.app has no Meta creds) shows new text 'تحديث فوري للصرف اليوم' and the old 'مزامنة Meta الآن' is absent from the entire meta-ads-section subtree; meta-sync-now-btn label='تحديث فوري للصرف اليوم'; meta-go-settings-btn href='/settings'. All removed Meta testids confirmed absent: meta-cpa-month, meta-performance-row, meta-cpc-month, meta-cpm-month, meta-ctr-month, meta-impressions-month, meta-clicks-month, meta-campaigns-table. Snap refresh click → POST /api/snapchat/daily-spend/bulk body={from_date:'2026-05-31', to_date:'2026-05-31'} verified via network panel; Meta refresh click → POST /api/meta/sync body={"days":1} verified. Both return HTTP 400 because admin has no provider creds — toasts displayed (acceptable per contract). /reports/ads loads cleanly via snap footer link; data-testid='ads-report-page' present. Backend regression: test_unified_ads_report.py (5/5) + test_operating_expenses.py (16/16) = 21/21 PASS in 25.79s.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx snap section (lines 344-491) and meta section (lines 534-686) look clean: each card has exactly 4 today + 4 month tiles in a 2-col mobile / 4-col lg grid; ROAS tile colors flip emerald/amber at >=2x threshold; the '—' fallback when spend==0 is consistent across snap and meta and matches the 'ROAS = sales/spend, 0 if spend==0' contract.

The footer hint text 'التفاصيل (CPC / CPM / CTR / الحملات) في تقرير الإعلانات الموحَّد ←' literally contains 'CPC / CPM / CTR'. This is INTENTIONAL (advertises what users will find in /reports/ads) and consistent on both snap and meta footers — not a regression.
Both refresh buttons return HTTP 400 with admin (no creds) — error.response.data.detail is surfaced via toast.error; UX is consistent. No console crashes.
Meta empty-state branch correctly hides the footer link meta-card-details-link (only renders in the non-empty branch). Matches the request note: 'will not appear in empty state — acceptable'.
Dashboard.jsx is 785 lines — at the upper end of the recommended file-size budget. Future refactor: extract <SnapchatAdsCard /> and <MetaAdsCard /> into their own files. Not blocking.
Two pre-existing recharts console warnings ('width(-1)/height(-1)') fire on the monthly chart's initial render. Cosmetic only, not introduced by this change.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 8 acceptance criteria verified end-to-end via Playwright)
